currentObjective: LINQ execution semantics and mappings implemented without new diagnostics
decisions: Known operations must be resolved through Roslyn symbols, not text-only method names.
Unsupported or unresolved invocations remain Unknown; the inherited conservative O(n) fallback is explicitly rejected.
Known operation mappings carry complexity, execution semantics, provenance, and diagnostic metadata.
KnownOperationMapping, KnownOperationRegistry, and KnownOperationResolver live under Analysis/KnownOperations with immutable value-oriented model objects and no Roslyn dependency under Model/.
KnownOperationRegistry.Bcl remains BCL-only; KnownOperationRegistry.Default combines BCL and LINQ mappings for extraction.
LINQ mappings cover high-value System.Linq.Enumerable immediate/materializing operations and deferred pipeline operations with official documentation/runtime-source provenance.
Deferred LINQ pipeline creation is charged as O(1); receiver enumeration is charged only when consumed by supported terminal operations or foreach.

Supported consumed pipeline chains compose source enumeration, predicate/selector local lambda complexity, materialization, and ordering without artificial double-counting of Where/Select plus ToList/ToArray.
OrderBy/OrderByDescending/ThenBy/ThenByDescending remain deferred at creation, but sorting complexity is counted when consumed.
Count() specializes to O(1) only when the receiver semantic type safely exposes ICollection/ICollection<T> count or array length; generic IEnumerable remains O(n).
LINQ lambdas are analyzed only locally; unresolved invocation work inside consumed predicates/selectors preserves Unknown.
Foreach now has the minimal contract needed to account for consumed deferred LINQ pipelines without introducing diagnostics.
No public diagnostics were added in step 4.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not copy the inherited BCL registry wholesale.
Do not implement call graph, interprocedural analysis, recursion, recurrence solving, Workspaces, CodeFix, memory complexity, parallel complexity, or probabilistic complexity in Phase 4.
Do not change BIG9000 unless a later explicit spec changes that contract.
Respect CancellationToken and keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, immutable, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
validations: Known-operation infrastructure tests cover exact match, unknown lookup, overload distinction, custom same-name non-match, reduced extension resolution, deterministic registry ordering, concurrent read behavior, and Unknown not becoming O(n).

Core BCL mapping tests cover List<T>.Count/indexer/Contains/IndexOf/Sort overloads, Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.ContainsKey/ContainsValue, HashSet<T>.Contains, Array.Length, string.Length, custom homonymous List<T>.Contains, verified or explicitly conservative provenance, and absence of LINQ mappings from the BCL-only registry.
LINQ mapping tests cover semantic resolution and provenance for Where, Select, OrderBy, Distinct, GroupBy, ToList, Any, Count, and Contains plus custom homonymous extensions.

Method extraction tests cover Where without consumption, Where+ToList, Select+ToArray, OrderBy without consumption, OrderBy+ToList, Any, Contains, Count specialization, foreach over pipeline, custom Where/Any extensions, nested/chained operators, SelectMany with known inner receiver, and unresolved consumed predicate preserving Unknown.
knownPendingItems: Integrate invocation analysis with public diagnostics in the next Phase 4 step.
Add BIG0001 and BIG100x diagnostics only after descriptor/release/documentation updates and tests.
